{{Quote|Ever since the XP-38 came out, they just aren't in demand.|Luke Skywalker upon selling his X-34 landspeeder, which was bought by Wioslea|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Wioslea''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[Vuvrian]] who was a terrestrial vehicle sales [[merchant]]. Like others of her [[species]], she had a large head with dual [[Limb|tentacles]] and [[eye]]s in multiple shapes and [[color]]s.<ref name="Geektionary" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> she bought [[Luke Skywalker]]'s [[X-34 landspeeder]] in [[Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine]]<ref name="ANH" /> for two thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> The Vuvrian stood around the same height as Skywalker and his [[Jedi Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and had two arms that were each attached with a flat, green appendage that articulated to form a cupped hand.<ref name="ANH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ANHaliengroupshot.jpg|thumb|right|280px|A photograph of aliens behind the scenes of ''A New Hope'', including Wioslea]]
Wioslea first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The character was designed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] himself.<ref name="OM">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref>
